# Om Batavia

> Personal portfolio of Om Batavia, an AI systems builder and student entrepreneur in Ahmedabad, India.

Canonical website: https://www.ombatavia.com/

## Core work

- Smart Invoices / Smart Kirana: AI-assisted supplier invoice extraction, inventory tracking, and restock workflows for Indian retailers and wholesalers.
- ALTSELF: AI model-routing infrastructure that balances task complexity, output quality, latency, and cost.
- AI Lost & Found: visual and metadata matching concept with QR-assisted claim flows for campuses and venues.

## Profile

- Founder roles: ALTSELF and Smart Invoices.
- TEC Teen Shop CEO and Growth Valley Team Lead.
- Topics: AI orchestration, invoice automation, retail systems, visual matching, full-stack development, and product engineering.
- Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
